crossRefs.note: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.
At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck…
Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.
“When I had returned to Jerusalem, and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance,
he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty…
In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat…
The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the captives. So the vision…
In the visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, on which was…
I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t…
I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet
Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne
that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

translations.web: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.
translations.bsb: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, but while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.
translations.kjv: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
translations.asv: and he became hungry, and desired to eat: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance;
